== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|dragons{{!}}Dragon's Edge is a [[Perfected]] dreadnought vessel utilized by The Perfected{{!}}the Perfected forces. Functioning as an armed, floating city, the ship is a significant threat on the battlefield capable of engaging in direct combat. During maneuvers, it has been observed reversing course to engage enemies and activating its central cannons to intensify fire. The vessel's presence is formidable enough that it requires the concentrated attention of [[The Last Horizon]] to keep it pinned down, as failing to monitor its movements could result in immediate defeat.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The dragons{{!}}Dragon’s Edge is a [[Perfected]] dreadnought identified by Kelthriss of the Burning Rain{{!}}Kelthriss as a specific unit. During combat, this vessel is capable of activating its central cannons. However, the ship finds itself pinned down and kept in check by [[The Last Horizon]].}}
